newsitem.title: UK: Active soft oils trade wakes up European veg oils.
newsitem.headline: Active soft oils trade wakes up European veg oils.

text.p: A burst of active trading in soft oils woke the slumbering European vegetable oils during Friday afternoon.
The market had looked set to drift quietly into the weekend after the holiday on Wednesday and Thursday.
Crushers were active on both sides of the soft oil market with rape oil attracting the bulk of the business.
"We've seen crushers, shippers and dealers in the market this afternoon and there has been a good turnover," said one trader.
Traders could give no reason for the interest, but said it was probably someone covering positions.
Dutch soy oil closed 0.25 guilders up after May traded at 105.25 and 105, Aug/Oct at 108.50 and 109 and Nov/Jan at 107 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Dutch/EU rape oil finished 0.50 guilders down after May fetched 107, Aug/Sep 107.25, 107 and back to 107.25 guilders.
Nov/Jan traded at 108 and 108.25 guilders a 1200 kilos fob ex-mill.
Traders said the business was a mix of switching and outright trades.
Coconut oils was another sector to come alive during the afternoon in mainly dealer trading.
Offers were as much as $15 down by the close, but traders said this was only to be expected on the market that had not traded for a couple of days.
"The market is just catching up on itself," said one.
Apr/May coconut oil traded at $697.50 and $695, May/Jun at $685, Jun/Jul at $680 and Aug/Sep $670 a tonne cif.
Palm oil remained quiet during the afternoon with higher prices in Malaysia underpinning the market.
Crude palm oil finished $2.50 up after Apr traded at $570 a tonne cif.

Products closed $2.50 up after RBD oil traded at $574 for May and $654 for Jun while olein fetched $607.50 for May, $597.50 for Jun, $587.50 and $590 for Jul and $582.50 a tonne fob Malaysian ports for Jul/Aug.
Trading next week is expected to be slow with the U.K. closed on Monday for a public holiday and many European countries shut on Thursday for Ascension Day.
